archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Dark Mode variant with Electric Turquoise Accent
domain: AI Video Editor SaaS for Creators

rules: H1 must not exceed text-5xl sm:text-6xl with tracking-tight
Overlines must be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em]
Do NOT use Inter for anything.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_system: Use generous spacing, e.g., py-24 or py-32 for sections
layout_and_spacing.grid: Bento Grid (Mode A) for Feature Highlights. Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with wide gap-8 to gap-12.
layout_and_spacing.components: Go cardless or use subtle rounded-md (max 8px border-radius) with sharp technical edges.

animations.hero: CRITICAL: You MUST use react-tsparticles or framer-motion to create an immersive abstract animated visual background (gradients or particles) using charcoal and turquoise colors. Do not use a static image.
animations.interactions: Hover states must increase contrast, use translate-y-1 lift, and incorporate subtle turquoise glowing borders for feature cards.

instructions_to_main_agent.1_setup: Update tailwind variables in index.css to match the charcoal and turquoise palette. Install @phosphor-icons/react, framer-motion, react-tsparticles, and tsparticles.
instructions_to_main_agent.2_header: Create a minimal glassmorphic fixed header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#121316]/70) with Logo 'Rupert Joel' and 'Join Waitlist' button.
instructions_to_main_agent.3_hero_section: Must include abstract animated background (tsParticles or framer-motion). Implement a rotating headline (using framer-motion AnimatePresence) for the 3 variations. Overline text for the Urgency Banner ('First 500 get 50% off for life'). Subheadline must explicitly handle objections ('No manual timeline scrubbing needed. Keep full creative control while AI handles the grunt work.').
instructions_to_main_agent.4_rotating_headlines: 1. 'Cut Hours of Editing in One Click with AI First-Pass' 2. 'Automate Silence Removal & Summaries Instantly' 3. 'The First-Pass Video Editor for Smart Creators'
instructions_to_main_agent.5_waitlist_form: Email input + 'Get Early Access' primary button side-by-side. Below form: Social proof face pile (use the provided avatars) + 'Join 400+ creators' text. Include data-testid='waitlist-email-input' and 'waitlist-submit-button'.
instructions_to_main_agent.6_confirmation_state: When waitlist form is submitted, show a Confirmation Screen INLINE with a success message. Below it, add the P.S. validation question form: 'P.S. While you wait, what's your biggest editing bottleneck?' with a textarea and a secondary submit button.
instructions_to_main_agent.7_how_it_works: Vertical timeline or 3-step horizontal grid. Steps: 1. Upload Raw Footage, 2. AI First-Pass (Silence removal, WhisperX transcription), 3. Export to Premiere/FCP/DaVinci.
instructions_to_main_agent.8_feature_bento: Bento Grid layout. Highlight 'High-Accuracy WhisperX Transcription', 'One-Click Silence Removal', and 'Automated Chapter/Summary Generation'. Use 'Tracing Beam' or subtle glowing borders (turquoise) on hover for these cards.
instructions_to_main_agent.9_testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
